```{r}
source("functions.R")
pacman::p_load(tidybayes)
```




#read in a fit
```{r}
patient_id = 78


fit_path <- make_fit_path(patient_id = patient_id)
fit <- readRDS(fit_path)



```
# get a summary of param estimates for the patient
```{r}
fit$summary()
```



```{r}
#get draws in tidy format of vars of interest
draws <- fit$draws(c("cost", "turnover", "n0", "rFrac", "sigma", "rR", "dR", "starting_state")) |>
  spread_draws(cost, turnover, n0, rFrac, sigma, rR, dR, starting_state[j]) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = j, values_from = starting_state) |> #have to wrangle a bit to get starting states 
  rename(S0 = "1", R0 = "2") |> 
  select(c(-.chain, -.iteration)) #rename starting states 
  
draws
```
the draws can be used to plot posterior over any free or determined parameter
```{r}
ggplot(draws, aes(x=turnover)) +
  geom_density(fill = "orange") +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle(paste0("Turnover for Patient ID ", patient_id)) 
```

setup the biomarker functions. 
```{r}
#def func for see eq 3 in supplemental in Gallagher et al's biomarker paper "the time taken for a resistant sub-population of initial size R0 to reach Rf in the presence of κK sensitive cells
s3 <- function(k=.2, d, rR, R0, K = 1) {
  out <- ( 1 / (d - (1 - k)*rR) ) * (log( 1 + (rR*R0 / (d*K - (1-k)*K*rR+rR*R0)) ) - log(2))
  return(out)
}

#calc delta at given parameter draws
s4 <- function(k=.2, d, rR, R0, K = 1){
  numerator <- s3(k=k, d = d, rR = rR, R0 = R0, K = K) - s3(k=0, d = d, rR = rR, R0=R0, K = K)
  denominator <-                      s3(k=0, d = d, rR = rR, R0, K = K)
  return( numerator / denominator)
}

e

#eTTP is given by
S5 <- function(k=.2, d, rR, R0, K = 1) {
  out <- (1+s3(k=k, d = d, rR = rR, R0 = R0, K = K)) * TTP(S_0 = 0)
  return()
}


draws <- draws |> 
  mutate(delta_AT = s4(k=.2, d = dR, rR = rR, R0, K = 1)) |> 
  relocate(.draw, delta_AT) #rearrange for readability

draws

```
This sample can again be used for plotting
```{r}
ggplot(draws, aes(x=delta_AT)) +
  geom_density(fill = "lightblue") +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle(paste0("Delta AT for Patient ID ", patient_id)) +
  xlim(0,1)
```
